# Your hiring team. On demand.

          TaaSFlow is subscription recruiting for growing companies.
          We deliver pre-screened, ranked candidates in 14 days — with no
          placement fees and no salary percentages.

          
            [Start a $399 pilot](/pilot) ·
            [See how it works](/how-it-works) ·
            [View pricing](/pricing)
          

        
        
          ## What you get every week

          - A ranked shortlist of pre-screened candidates, scored 0–100 across Role Fit, Evidence, Logistics, and Signal.
- Recruiter-written fit narratives, strengths, and gaps for every candidate.
- A live dashboard to shortlist, interview, reject, or request more information in one click.
- Direct handover of candidate contact details once you shortlist — no gatekeeping.

## Who TaaSFlow is for

          - Founders and hiring managers who need to fill 3–20 roles a year without paying 20–25% placement fees.
- HR and talent leaders replacing unreliable agencies with a predictable subscription.
- Staffing agencies who need extra capacity to say yes to every client request.
- Enterprise teams hiring across the US, UAE, UK, and Brazil.

## Why subscription recruiting

          - Flat monthly fee from $6,999. No per-hire cost.
- First ranked shortlist in 7–14 days.
- Cancel or pause any time.
- 15% discount on annual plans.
